items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was met at the airport by Ernie Andrews, who took me to this little hotel I stayed at.

ctx.x: You flew out alone, as I recall.

Right. I was met at the airport by Ernie Andrews, who took me to this little hotel I stayed at. I don’t think my mother was in California then. At some point she was in California when I was out there. But it was a piece of cake. I just don’t – I just never felt that I was supposed to be nervous or anything. I figured that if Dave Cavanaugh didn’t want anybody else to hear it, that was good enough for me, and I loved the people that David Cavanaugh produced. I loved the production values.
Okay. We’ll start talking about albums in a minute. John had this notion, and he sent you out of the country.
